name: Silver Spigot
notes: not_found: Silver Spigot Cocktail Lounge is a dive bar (dartboards, pool tables, jukebox) at 2221 Morena Blvd. Its own domain silverspigot.com 301s to quinnslighthouse.com/press2.html, which actually serves cloaked/hijacked content (a Shopee e-commerce JS bundle, unrelated to any restaurant) -- a hijacked domain per playbook rule, barred outright. No ordering platform presence found (DoorDash/Grubhub/UberEats search turned up nothing). restaurantguru.com gives only a per-person price range ($10-$20), no per-item prices. menupix.com and Yelp both 403'd a curl fetch; weeblyte.com (a barred farm domain) also surfaced in search and was not used. Reviews describe it as serving snacks/small food under $15 but no source anywhere lists actual priced food items. Treating as a bar with no publishable per-item menu.

name: Saddle Bar
notes: not_found: Saddle Bar (Solana Beach) is a dive bar. Its own About page and a quoted customer review state explicitly: "They don't serve food but don't care if you bring in your own. You can even order from the Pillbox two doors up and their servers will bring the grub in the bar to you." No menu link anywhere on the site (checked homepage nav, wp-json pages). This is a drink-only bar with no per-item food prices to record.

name: The Clubhouse Grill
notes: First-party PDF menu from the resort's own site (Fairmont Grand Del Mar / granddelmar.com), filename dated 8.12.24, read with pdftotext -layout. The live URL 404s directly but the identical file (same content hash) is archived by the Wayback Machine across Apr 2025, Aug 2025 and Feb 2026 crawls, so it is treated as current, not stale; fetched via https://web.archive.org/web/20260216134318/<url>. The live site also links a menumodo.com embedded viewer (outlet 12128, menu 247521) for the same restaurant but that widget is fully client-rendered JS with no server-side data -- not usable without a browser, so this PDF was used instead. A stale SinglePlatform listing (Baja Fish Tacos $12) was checked and rejected: it undercuts this PDF's prices by roughly 2x with no clean fee ratio, which per the staleness rule means the SinglePlatform copy is simply an old page, not evidence of a markup. Categories reached: Starters, Mains, Salads, Dessert, weekly Daily Specials, Cocktails, Wine (red/white/sparkling/rose), Beer & Seltzer, Draft -- this is the restaurant's single combined lunch/dinner/bar menu (open 7:30am-6pm daily; the resort site separately mentions breakfast items served on guest patios/rooms, which is not covered by this PDF and not found priced elsewhere). Two-tier drink prices on the PDF (e.g. Longball John Daly $12/$20) recorded at the lower/base price with a note.

name: Contodo Fresh Mexican Eats
notes: Restaurant's own site (tacorestaurantsandiego.com, address confirmed 111 S Meadowbrook Dr matches work list -- domain name mismatch is just marketing branding, not a different business) prices nothing itself; it only teases Tacos/Burritos/Carne Asada Fries with 'read more' links and points to Grubhub, Zmenu and Seamless for ordering. Grubhub, Seamless and Zmenu were all unreadable without a browser (JS wall / 403). Found DoorDash's marketplace listing instead, which server-renders a full schema.org Menu JSON-LD (tier 3, medium at best per source ladder). Ran the markup divisor test (1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30) across all 46 priced items excluding the duplicate 'Most Ordered' showcase section -- no divisor lands more than 4/46 items on a round or .95 value, so this is ordinary odd-cent psychological pricing (dominated by .95 endings), not a delivery markup. No first-party dine-in artefact (PDF/photo/board) was found to cross-check against, so confidence stays medium rather than high. Categories reached: Tacos, Specialty Tacos, Burritos, Breakfast, Extras, Drinks, Sides -- this covers everything the restaurant's own site names as its specialties (tacos, burritos, carne asada fries -- fries/chips items appear under Extras). The 'Most Ordered' section was dropped as a duplicate of items already listed under their real sections.
